items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: A fella we used to play for back there, they called Loi, Loi Bartamana... we used to play for him.

ctx.x: He put it in the cell.

He asked you what number you like, you know what I mean? And he put it on. And he had a little grocery store too. See, and he was making money here over here. See? Alright. He turns around. A fella we used to play for back there, they called Loi, Loi Bartamana, an Italian fella. Now you talk with a bad luck man. Now he was bad luck for.
